## Change
Describe the behavior and which contract/rule is affected.

## Validation
- [ ] Synthetic regression or evidence explaining why one is unnecessary
- [ ] C++ export target checked
- [ ] macOS target checked (or concrete limitation recorded)
- [ ] No retail assets, game-derived C++, executables, captures or raw logs
- [ ] Shared fix or revision-gated title adapter identified
- [ ] Existing rule IDs/provenance preserved; new rules have regression fixtures

## Limitations
State untested behavior and whether a source-complete clean build was exercised.
